features.text: Specialized immobilization design maintains shoulder in the optimal position close to the body for enhanced recovery
Secure strapping system prevents unwanted shoulder movement while allowing necessary adjustments for comfort
Anatomically contoured fit provides targeted compression and stability for various shoulder conditions
Lightweight materials and ergonomic design ensure comfortable support during extended wear

measurement: For proper sizing and optimal therapeutic benefits, refer to our sizing chart or visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for complimentary sizing assistance from our medical professionals. Our team will help ensure you receive the perfect fit for your recovery needs.
